name: "BLAT" Beef Cheeseburger Sliders with Special Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut bacon crosswise into thirds.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook until crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
6 large leaf butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim and mince green onions. Place in a medium bowl along with beef, eggs, bread crumbs, Worcestershire, and spices. Use your hands to combine the beef mixture. Form into 12 equal-sized "meatballs" and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb lean ground beef
⅓ cup panko bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Working in batches, add meatballs to the skillet, spacing them out; press down with the bottom of a spatula to form ½-inch thick patties. Cook, undisturbed, until golden on one side, about 3 minutes.
While the burgers are cooking, cut cheese slices into quarters.

When the burgers are done on one side, flip and top each with two squares of cheese. Continue to cook until cheese melts and burgers are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove to a clean plate, then repeat with remaining meatballs and cheese.
Meanwhile, tear lettuce leaves into quarters. Transfer to another plate.
Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate with the lettuce.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate and set aside.
Place mayo, ketchup, and relish in a small bowl. Stir to combine the "special sauce" and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup ketchup
3 tbsp sweet pickle relish

instructions.primary_message: Split buns in half and toast if desired.

To assemble the burgers, spread special sauce on the bottom half of the buns. Top with lettuce, tomato, avocado, cheesy burger patties, and two strips of bacon. Close with the top half of the buns and secure with cocktail skewers (if desired).
Arrange burgers on a platter, share, and enjoy!
